name: Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the United Nations to renew the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum permanently. This forum is a place where governments, companies and civil society discuss how the internet is run. Its current mandate runs out on 31 December 2025, and the UN General Assembly is due to review it in autumn 2025. The Parliament also wants the forum to get more resources and wants the EU to keep supporting it. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament calls for the forum's mandate to be renewed permanently.
- **Who it affects:** The United Nations, EU governments, the European Commission, and everyone who uses the internet.
- **What happens next:** The UN General Assembly reviews the mandate in autumn 2025; the EU is urged to push for a positive result by the end of the year.
